through: The cat crept through the hole in the fence.
We walked through the park to get to school.
Sunlight shone through the curtains this morning.
important: Mum said the letter was important, so I kept it safe.
Wait, don't throw that away, it is important!
Keep this ticket safe because it is important.
suppose: Fine, I suppose I can share my last biscuit.
I suppose I should tidy my room before tea, shouldn't I?
Do you suppose I could have a turn on the swing?
accident: Nobody meant to break the plate, so it was an accident.
I am sorry, the spilt juice was an accident!
Did the kitten knock over the plant pot by accident?
actually: I thought the shop was shut, but it is actually open.
The cake looks plain, but it actually tastes of lemon.
What is actually inside this big box?
business: My aunt started a business selling cakes at the market.
The shop is a family business, so everyone helps out.
Which business sells the best ice cream in town?
pressure: Use gentle pressure when you press the clay flat.
Squeeze the toothpaste tube and the pressure pushes it out.
Too much pressure from heavy snow bent the shed roof.
imagine: Close your eyes and imagine a beach with warm golden sand.
Can you imagine a cake as big as a house?
I love to imagine pictures in my head before I paint.
different: Is this the same book or a different one?
Our new house feels different from our old one.
Each of the cats has a different colour of fur.
difficult: The jar lid was so tight that it was difficult to open.
Is this maths question too difficult for us?
What a difficult jigsaw, with so many bits that look alike!
disappear: The sun will disappear behind the clouds soon.
The footprints on the beach disappear when the tide comes in.
Why does my sock always disappear in the wash?
